query: What patient needs appear in visit notes?

per_column.name: primary_patient_need
per_column.rationale: This is a free-text label naming the whole patient need itself (e.g., 'Acute ear infection treatment'), not an aspect OF the need. It restates the entire concept rather than carving out a constitutive part such as clinical, functional, informational, or emotional need.

per_column.name: patient_need_category
per_column.rationale: This is a single categorical classification of the whole need (Chronic/Urgent/Preventive/etc.), i.e., a taxonomy of the concept as a whole, not a distinct facet that decomposes the need into non-overlapping aspects.

judge.rationale: Neither column is a constitutive facet (part-of) of 'patient_needs'. Both restate the whole need at different granularities: 'primary_patient_need' is a fine-grained label of the need itself, and 'patient_need_category' is a coarse classification of that same need. A genuine faceted decomposition would split the need into aspects such as clinical/medical need, functional need, informational need, and psychosocial/emotional need. Because both columns describe the same underlying whole (one is essentially a rollup of the other), mutual exclusivity is low and exhaustiveness across the concept's constitutive aspects is essentially unmet.
